cards.questionText:
Read the following business card.
Elaine’s Alterations
529 Cambridge Avenue ♦ 555-3223
Elaine Smith, Owner
Custom alterations for suits, dresses, and more.
Quick Hemming Service: Trousers shortened while you wait!
Mon. - Fri.: 9 A.M. - 6 P.M. / Sat.: 10 A.M. - 4 P.M.

childQuestions.questionText: What service can be performed within a short time?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "Quick Hemming Service: Trousers shortened while you wait!"
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Dịch vụ nào có thể được thực hiện trong thời gian ngắn?

(A) Sửa áo khoác tom suit

(B) Thay thế các nút bị thiếu trên quần áo

(C) Điều chỉnh độ dài của quần

(D) Lấy số đo cho những chiếc váy theo yêu cầu

childQuestions.questionText: What is suggested about Elaine’s Alterations?
options: (C) It sells a variety of fabric.

Information is in "Mon. - Fri.: 9 A.M. - 6 P.M. / Sat.: 10 A.M. - 4 P.M."

Điều gì được gợi ý về Sự thay đổi của Elaine?

(B) Nó chỉ có một nhân viên.

(C) Nó bán nhiều loại vải.

(D) Nó đóng cửa vào Chủ Nhật.

-> Không có giờ làm việc vào ngày chủ nhật.

=> Chọn D

cards.questionText:
Read the following e-mail.
To: Larry Morgan <morgan.l@crescentinc.com>
From: Celeste Ross <ross.c@crescentinc.com>
Date: December 2
Subject: Monthly Meeting
Dear Mr. Morgan,
I am writing to inform you that the monthly managers meeting scheduled for December 3 has been pushed back by half an hour, so it will begin at 3:30. This is due to a scheduling conflict with the conference room. We still expect the meeting to last approximately one hour. If there is anything you think should be covered at the meeting, please e-mail me by the end of the day. That way, I can formally add it to the agenda.
See you tomorrow!
Celeste</ross.c@crescentinc.com></morgan.l@crescentinc.com>

childQuestions.questionText: What has changed about a meeting?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "I am writing to inform you that the monthly managers meeting scheduled for December 3 has been pushed back by half an hour, so it will begin at 3:30."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Điều gì đã thay đổi về một cuộc họp?

(A) Ngày

(B) Vị trí

(C) Thời gian bắt đầu

(D) Thời lượng

Thông tin: "I am writing to inform you that the monthly managers meeting scheduled for December 3 has been pushed back by half an hour, so it will begin at 3:30."

(Tôi viết thư này để thông báo với các bạn rằng cuộc họp hàng tháng của các nhà quản lý dự kiến vào ngày 3 tháng 12 đã bị lùi lại nửa giờ nên sẽ bắt đầu lúc 3:30.)

=> Chọn C

childQuestions.questionText: Why should Mr. Morgan write to Ms. Ross?
options: (A) To suggest a topic for discussion
(B) To confirm his attendance at a meeting
(C) To provide a copy of the agenda
(D) To warn her about a scheduling problem
correctOptions: (A) To suggest a topic for discussion
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "If there is anything you think should be covered at the meeting, please e-mail me by the end of the day."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Tại sao ông Morgan nên viết thư cho cô Ross?

(A) Để gợi ý một chủ đề thảo luận

(B) Để xác nhận sự tham dự của anh ấy tại một cuộc họp

(C) Để cung cấp một bản sao của chương trình nghị sự

(D) Để cảnh báo cô ấy về vấn đề sắp xếp lịch

Thông tin: "If there is anything you think should be covered at the meeting, please e-mail me by the end of the day."

(Nếu bạn nghĩ có điều gì cần được đề cập trong cuộc họp, vui lòng gửi email cho tôi vào cuối ngày.)

=> Chọn A

cards.questionText:
Read the following text-message chain.
Ivan Mathiasen [9:20 A.M.]
I sent you an e-mail with the business proposal for Seneca Hospitality. I'm wondering if you've had a chance to check it out.
Amina Behane [9:23 A.M]
I have a major customer visiting my office soon, but I can take a quick look now.
Ivan Mathiasen [9:24 A.M]
Thanks. I just want to make sure that I've covered everything.
Amina Behane [9:25 A.M]
There are a few adjustments to be made, but that's normal. I've had to coach your other team members on the same issues. Let's meet after lunch to discuss it.
Ivan Mathiasen [9:26 A.M.]
Okay, I'm free anytime.
Amina Behane [9:27 A.M]
That's her now. I'll call you when I'm done.

childQuestions.questionText: What is implied about Ms. Behane?
options: (B) She had some trouble receiving an e-mail.
(D) She used to work for Seneca Hospitality.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on information "I'm wondering if you've had a chance to check it out.", "I just want to make sure that I've covered everything.", "I've had to coach your other team members on the same issues."

=> It can be inferred that Ms. Behane is Mr. Mathiasen’s supervisor.
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Điều gì được ngụ ý về bà Behane?

(A) Bà ấy yêu cầu một số số liệu cập nhật.

(B) Bà ấy gặp chút khó khăn khi nhận e-mail.

(C) Bà ấy là người giám sát của ông Mathiasen.

(D) Bà ấy từng làm việc cho Seneca Hospitality.

Thông tin:  "I'm wondering if you've had a chance to check it out." (Tôi tự hỏi liệu bạn có cơ hội kiểm tra nó không.)

"I just want to make sure that I've covered everything." (Tôi chỉ muốn đảm bảo rằng tôi đã trình bày mọi thứ)

"I've had to coach your other team members on the same issues." (Tôi đã phải huấn luyện các thành viên khác trong nhóm của bạn về những vấn đề tương tự)

--> Có thể suy ra rằng bà Behane là người giám sát của ông Mathiasen.

=> Chọn C

childQuestions.questionText: At 9:27 A.M., what does Ms. Behane mean when she writes, “That’s her now”?
options: (B) A career coach is highly recommended.
(D) A coworker will cover Ms. Behane’s duties.
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on information "I have a major customer visiting my office soon"

=> Choose A
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Lúc 9:27 sáng, bà Behane có ý gì khi viết “That’s her now”?

(A) Một khách hàng quan trọng đã đến.

(B) Một huấn luyện viên nghề nghiệp rất được khuyến khích.

(C) Một đồng nghiệp có thể trả lời các câu hỏi.

(D) Một đồng nghiệp sẽ đảm nhận nhiệm vụ của cô Behane.

Thông tin: "I have a major customer visiting my office soon" (Sắp có một khách hàng lớn đến thăm văn phòng của tôi)

=> Chọn A

cards.questionText:

(Ứng dụng điện thoại thông minh Vision-ITD cho phép bạn lập trình từ xa cho TV thông minh của mình để ghi lại một chương trình)

childQuestions.questionText: What do customers need to provide when signing up for the service?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "Input your customer number from your cable service provider."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Khách hàng cần cung cấp những gì khi đăng ký dịch vụ?

(A) Một thẻ căn cước

(B) Mã số khách hàng

Thông tin: "Input your customer number from your cable service provider."

(Nhập số khách hàng của bạn từ nhà cung cấp dịch vụ cáp của bạn.)

=> Chọn B

cards.questionText:
Read the following review.
Business: Cerritos Flooring
Reviewer: Ruben Ives
Rating: 5/5
I would highly recommend Cerritos Flooring to anyone who is considering having hardwood floors installed. When choosing a company, I just went for the cheapest one, so I wasn’t sure whether the quality of the work would be good enough. However, I was pleasantly surprised. I only had to wait a few days to get an appointment, and the crew arrived in the morning on time and with all of the tools they needed. They performed the work efficiently. What I really thought was amazing was that they vacuumed and cleaned up everything before they left. No one would even be able to guess that they had been there! I’ve had the new floor for two weeks, and it looks fantastic. I’m sure it will look as good as new for many years to come.
The one thing I would suggest is to make sure your corridor is empty prior to your appointment. I forgot to do this, which made bringing in the supplies somewhat difficult for the workers, as they were being very careful not to break anything along the way.

childQuestions.questionText: Why did Mr. Ives select Cerritos Flooring?
options: (B) It was recommended by a friend.
(D) It was nearest to his home.
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "I would highly recommend Cerritos Flooring to anyone who is considering having hardwood floors installed. When choosing a company, I just went for the cheapest one"
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Tại sao ông Ives chọn Sàn Cerritos?

(A) Nó có giá thấp nhất.

(B) Nó được một người bạn giới thiệu.

(C) Nó có danh tiếng tốt.

(D) Nó gần nhà anh ấy nhất.

Thông tin: "I would highly recommend Cerritos Flooring to anyone who is considering having hardwood floors installed. When choosing a company, I just went for the cheapest one"

(Tôi thực sự muốn giới thiệu Sàn Cerritos cho bất kỳ ai đang cân nhắc việc lắp đặt sàn gỗ cứng. Khi chọn một công ty, tôi chỉ chọn công ty rẻ nhất)

=> Chọn A

childQuestions.questionText: What impressed Mr. Ives most about the service?
options: (A) It was available on the same day as ordering.
(B) The work comes With a warranty.
(C) It was completed ahead of schedule.
(D) The crew did not leave behind a mess.
correctOptions: (D) The crew did not leave behind a mess.
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "What I really thought was amazing was that they vacuumed and cleaned up everything before they left."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Điều gì khiến ông Ives ấn tượng nhất về dịch vụ?

(A) Nó có sẵn vào cùng ngày đặt hàng.

(B) Công việc đi kèm với bảo hành.

(C) Nó đã được hoàn thành trước thời hạn.

(D) Phi hành đoàn đã không để lại một mớ hỗn độn nào.

Thông tin: "What I really thought was amazing was that they vacuumed and cleaned up everything before they left."

(Điều tôi thực sự nghĩ là tuyệt vời là họ đã hút bụi và dọn dẹp mọi thứ trước khi rời đi)

=> Chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: What does Mr. Ives suggest doing?
options: (B) Checking the floor after two weeks
(D) Reporting broken items to the company
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "The one thing I would suggest is to make sure your corridor is empty prior to your appointment."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Ông Ives đề nghị làm gì?

(A) Đặt cuộc hẹn buổi sáng

(B) Kiểm tra sàn sau hai tuần

(C) Loại bỏ các vật dụng khỏi hành lang

(D) Báo cáo các mặt hàng bị hỏng cho công ty

Thông tin: "The one thing I would suggest is to make sure your corridor is empty prior to your appointment."

(Một điều tôi muốn đề xuất là đảm bảo hành lang của bạn gọn gàng trước cuộc hẹn.)

=> Chọn C

cards.questionText:
Read the following article.
Web Site Upgrade Expected to Boost Visits
(February 22)—The Maywood city government has launched an upgraded version of its Web site to appeal to more residents. Tills is the first major change to the site in more than fifteen years.
As before, visitors to the site can search for activities by date, as well as access a database of community-related documents. The most noticeable new feature is an online gallery where registered users can upload images of community activities. —[1]—.
Some residents expressed concern about the cost of upgrading the Web site, as the city spent over $20,000 for the project. “With a population as small as ours, it’s difficult to justify investing in something that was already working perfectly,” said Joshua Quentin, a business owner in Maywood. —[2]—.
City officials hope that the new Web site will create a renewed interest in Maywood’s local activities. —[3]—. For example, the annual Summer Singing Contest and the Riverside Litter
Collection Day are opportunities this month for residents to get together. The Web site also has the technology to broadcast live video streams, a system that will debut during next week’s debate I among candidates for state senator. —[4]—. It will also be used to broadcast the regional festivals throughout this year.

childQuestions.questionText: What has been added to the city’s Web site?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "The most noticeable new feature is an online gallery where registered users can upload images of community activities."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Những gì đã được thêm vào trang web của thành phố?

(A) Một bộ sưu tập các bức ảnh

(B) Lịch tương tác

(C) Một công cụ tìm kiếm

(D) Tính năng quay video

Thông tin: "The most noticeable new feature is an online gallery where registered users can upload images of community activities."

(Tính năng mới đáng chú ý nhất là thư viện trực tuyến nơi người dùng đã đăng ký có thể tải lên hình ảnh về các hoạt động cộng đồng.)

=> Chọn A

childQuestions.questionText: What is NOT indicated as an upcoming event in Maywood?
childQuestions.transcript:
"the annual Summer Singing Contest and the Riverside Litter Collection Day are opportunities this month for residents to get together." => Eliminate A&D

"The Web site also has the technology to broadcast live video streams, a system that will debut during next week’s debate among candidates for state senator."  => Eliminate C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Điều gì KHÔNG được chỉ định là sự kiện sắp diễn ra ở Maywood?

(A) Một cuộc thi âm nhạc

(B) Một cuộc đua thể thao

(C) Một cuộc tranh luận chính trị

(D) Một dự án dọn dẹp

Thông tin:

"the annual Summer Singing Contest and the Riverside Litter Collection Day are opportunities this month for residents to get together." 

(Cuộc thi Hát Mùa hè hàng năm và Ngày thu gom rác ven sông là cơ hội để người dân tụ tập trong tháng này) => Loại A&D

"The Web site also has the technology to broadcast live video streams, a system that will debut during next week’s debate among candidates for state senator." 

(Trang web này cũng có công nghệ phát sóng video trực tiếp, một hệ thống sẽ ra mắt trong cuộc tranh luận giữa các ứng cử viên cho chức thượng nghị sĩ bang vào tuần tới) => Loại C

=> Chọn B

childQuestions.questionText:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
“Nonetheless, most people thought the site was outdated and that the change was necessary.”
childQuestions.transcript: B is correct because it can connect with the sentences "Some residents expressed concern about the cost of upgrading the Web site, as the city spent over $20,000 for the project.", "City officials hope that the new Web site will create a renewed interest in Maywood’s local activities."
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Câu sau đây thuộc về vị trí nào được đánh dấu [1], [2], [3] và [4]?

“Tuy nhiên, hầu hết mọi người đều cho rằng trang web đã lỗi thời và việc thay đổi là cần thiết.”

B đúng vì nó có thể liên kết với các câu "Some residents expressed concern about the cost of upgrading the Web site, as the city spent over $20,000 for the project.", "City officials hope that the new Web site will create a renewed interest in Maywood’s local activities."

cards.questionText:
Read the following e-mail.
To: Madison Seneca<mseneca@professionaltrammg.net>
From: Davi Gomez <gomez_davi@blaine-inc.com>
Date: January 29
Subject: Professional Training: February Event
Dear Ms. Seneca,
As you know, Professional Training will hold its next training event on Friday, February 12. We had scheduled you for two one-hour talks. childQuestions.questionText: What does Ms. Seneca most likely specialize in?
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on information "Using the Power of the Web to Advertise Your Business.”

Tại sao ông Gomez lại gửi e-mail?

(B) Để phê duyệt một đề xuất trình bày

(C) Để báo cáo việc hủy bỏ

(D) Để đăng ký một sự kiện đào tạo

(Thật không may, một trong số họ đã bị loại khỏi lịch trình do số lượng tuyển sinh thấp.)

=> Chọn D

childQuestions.questionText: What is Ms. Seneca encouraged to do by February 6?
childQuestions.transcript: Information is in "You are welcome to attend one of the other talks or workshops on that day at no charge, and I highly encourage you to do so. Please e-mail me back by February 6 to let me know your top choice so that I may issue you a pass."

cards.questionText:
Read the following article.
PENNSWOOD, January 19—An independent firm has reviewed the state’s economic figures and estimated that the number of visitors to the state has dropped by 7.3 percent compared to last year, with revenues from this sector reaching approximately $3.2 billion. —[1]—.
A variety of businesses, such as hotels and restaurants, are directly affected by these figures, as they heavily depend on spending from tourists to keep them in business. — [2]—. “If my rooms are vacant,” says hotel owner Mathew Ledford, “I can’t keep my staff working full-time.”
Tourism Director Kathleen Renfrow said that the recently released figures should be put in context. “Last year was the 100th celebration of the erection of the Human Freedom Monument,” she said. “That event brought in many more tourists than usual, so it’s not a fair comparison. To get a better picture of how we are performing, it would better to compare the figures to those of two years ago. —[3]—. Our office is continually looking for ways to generate interest in our state, and we have a variety of activities—such as boating festivals and sports tournaments—to raise our profile.”
In order to make these types of events a success, adequate funding is needed. Fortunately, it seems likely that the tourism industry will be a top priority in budgetary considerations. All three people running for governor this fall—Melvin Ramey, Ann Alvarez, and Luke Zimmer—have publicly shown support for investing in the state’s tourism industry as a way of generating tax income and enriching communities across the state. —[4]—.

childQuestions.questionText: What is the article mainly about?
options: (A) A proposed tax on tourism businesses
childQuestions.transcript:
Based on information "estimated that the number of visitors to the state has dropped by 7.3 percent compared to last year, with revenues from this sector reaching approximately $3.2 billion.", "A variety of businesses, such as hotels and restaurants, are directly affected by these figures, as they heavily depend on spending from tourists to keep them in business."

=> Choose B
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Bài viết chủ yếu nói về điều gì?

(A) Thuế đề xuất đối với các doanh nghiệp du lịch

(B) Giảm du lịch

(C) Một chiến dịch quảng cáo dành cho khách du lịch

(D) Một địa điểm du lịch mới

cards.questionText:
Read the following job posting.
Now Hiring: Senior Administrative Assistant
Salco Community College is seeking a full-time senior administrative assistant. Preference will be given to candidates who can start immediately.
The senior administrative assistant is responsible for a variety of tasks to help keep the office running smoothly, and this position would be ideal for a person who likes changing activities frequently and who can work under pressure. Duties include responding to information requests from the community; booking flights, hotels, and vehicle rentals for staff members’ business trips; contributing content to a monthly newsletter; and monitoring the office’s expenditures. An annual salary of approximately $28,000 (negotiable) is offered along with four weeks of paid vacation and medical insurance.
To apply, send a resume and cover letter to hr@salcocc.edu on or before April 7. Our hiring committee will review the applications on April 8, and successful applicants will be contacted the following day to set up an interview. Interviews will most likely be held on April 11. Those who come to our office for an interview will also be asked to take a computer-based skills examination. Questions about the hiring process may be directed to the e-mail address listed above. We also accept inquiries by phone at 555- 7931 during regular business hours.
